thread:
Maya R.: Hey team — NovaEdge APAC raised a blocker: their marketplace PO is failing validation. Portal error: "EIN does not match billing entity". They need the order processed today to meet a reseller commit. Anyone free to help? :grimacing:
Tom B. (Finance): Can you drop the PO and the partner's EIN? I want to confirm if it's a data entry problem or an alias issue.
Maya R.: PO link (private): https://files.redwood/novaedge/po-3421.pdf. Partner supplied EIN: 88-7773330. Our marketplace ledger shows 88-7773300 (digits swapped).
OpsBot: System: PO upload failed \u2014 code MKT-ENTITY-MISMATCH. Manual remediation required for alias correction or affidavit.
Iris G. (Legal): We accept partner-signed corrective docs in these cases. We need either (A) a corrected signed PO with the right EIN, or (B) a signed attestation from the partner authorizing us to treat the two EINs as aliases for this order. Which can they provide quickly?
Priya S. (Sales): AM on the line says they can send a signed attestation within 90 minutes, or re-issue a corrected PO but that might take 3+ hours. Time-sensitive — they prefer the attestation route.
Tom B. (Finance): Fine by me if Legal approves wording. If we do a ledger override I'll log an audit entry and create a finance ticket. We need signed attachment before I flip anything.
Maya R.: Region is apac-east-1. Portal path: https://marketplace.apac.redwood/orders/3421. Ops note: APAC validations check EIN vs. vendor registry more strictly than NA.
Iris G. (Legal): Drafting a short attestation template now. Will include explicit reference to PO #3421, both EINs, and confirm signatory authority.
Iris G. (Legal): Attestation stub: "We, NovaEdge Ltd., confirm that EIN 88-7773330 and 88-7773300 both refer to NovaEdge Ltd. for the purposes of Purchase Order #3421. The signatory below is authorized to bind NovaEdge Ltd. to the obligations of the PO"
Priya S. (Sales): Sending stub to AM. AM says procurement can scan and send back within 45 mins. Sending ETA to partner: 45 mins.
OpsBot: System: Manual remediation ticket created #MP-8732. Pending attachments from partner and legal sign-off.
Tom B. (Finance): Once attestation is attached to MP-8732 I can create a temporary alias mapping in the ledger (expires after 30 days) and note audit ref FIN-T-211. Will notify accounting.
Maya R.: Plan: (1) Partner sends scanned attestation & signatory ID, (2) Iris finalizes attestation + uploads to MP-8732, (3) Tom applies temporary alias and records audit note, (4) Ops retries PO upload and confirms acceptance.
Priya S. (Sales): Partner uploaded scanned attestation and signer's passport scan to the ticket — forwarded to Legal.
Iris G. (Legal): Reviewed signature and ID. Acceptable. Uploaded final attestation PDF to MP-8732 and added one-line legal approval.
Tom B. (Finance): Applying temporary alias now... ledger update done (alias ID: ALIAS-APAC-442). Audit entry FIN-T-211 attached to ticket.
OpsBot: System: MP-8732 updated: attachments present; alias added. Ready for portal retry.
Maya R.: Retried POST via API:

POST /api/v1/orders/submit
Header: x-region: apac-east-1
Body: { "po_number": "3421", "e_in": "88-7773330" }

OpsBot: System: Portal accepted order 3421. Status: ACCEPTED.
Priya S. (Sales): Partner confirmed. Shipment window preserved. Great job all.
Iris G. (Legal): I'll add the attestation template to the partnerships playbook and tag it for localization for APAC.
Tom B. (Finance): I'll follow up with an automation request to reduce alias churn — nightly sync with partner registry.
Maya R.: I'll close MP-8732 and write a one-paragraph runbook for partnership onboarding to prevent this (field-entry checklist + expectations on EIN formatting). Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
